summary: 8 criteria exercised with 10 browser checks + 6 backend tests (one pytest file per API-bearing criterion). 1 confirmed frontend bug (login error toast shows generic message instead of backend's real 'incorreto' text). Supabase registration criterion is blocked in this environment: the project's email-send rate limit (max ~2 confirmation emails/hour, per briefing) was already exhausted by prior test runs, so /auth/register now returns a generic 400 instead of 201 — this is an environment/quota limitation, not an app defect (backend code path and duplicate/403-unconfirmed logic were already validated when budget was available, see spec_deviations).

bugs.criterion: Login real via Supabase rejeita credenciais erradas
bugs.description: Backend correctly returns 401 with detail 'E-mail ou senha incorretos.' for wrong credentials (verified by backend test, passes). However the frontend login form shows the WRONG toast text: 'Sua sessão expirou — faça login novamente.' instead of the backend's real message. Root cause: the shared errMessage()/API-error handler in the frontend (lib/queries.ts style helper) special-cases ALL HTTP 401 responses as 'session expired', masking the login-specific message intended by the spec.
bugs.evidence: Browser check 'login-invalid-shows-error-toast': POST /api/auth/login returned 401 with body {"detail":"E-mail ou senha incorretos."} (confirmed in backend test_tscheck_login_invalid_credentials.py — PASSED), but the on-screen toast text captured was 'sua sessão expirou — faça login novamente.' instead of containing 'incorret'. Screenshot: login-invalid-shows-error-toast-toast-visible.png.

action_items.description: Supabase registration (/auth/register) is rate-limited for this project's email sending. Both the backend test and the browser check for the 2-step cadastro flow now receive 400 'Não foi possível criar a conta' from Supabase (logs show prior 429 Too Many Requests on /auth/v1/signup), because the budget of ~2 confirmation emails/hour noted in the briefing was already used by earlier test runs in this session's history. No further /auth/register calls should be attempted until the Supabase rate limit window resets. This blocks full end-to-end verification of: 'cadastro 2 passos' toast text, duplicate-email 409, and the subsequent unconfirmed-login 403 — these were previously validated when the test suite was first authored (code paths unchanged).
